resources.title: Driftwood Architecture & Naming Reference
resources.description: Lesson 2's complete architecture diagram and resource-naming table — every database, schema, warehouse, role, DAG, and repo name used throughout the capstone, in one place. Reuse the naming pattern (a consistent project prefix, split for Snowflake's underscore-only identifiers) for your own project.

resources.title: RBAC and Masking Policy Templates
resources.description: Lesson 9's real role hierarchy and masking policy SQL, as reusable templates — a three-role pattern (service/analyst/compliance) and a CASE/CURRENT_ROLE() masking policy you can adapt to protect any PII column.

resources.title: Interview Story Arc Template
resources.description: Lesson 14's five-beat presentation structure (problem, architecture, build, production practices, results) as a fill-in template, plus the "what would you do at scale" answer pattern — reusable for presenting this capstone or any future project.

resources.title: Data Project Review Rubric
resources.description: A five-dimension rubric (correctness, testing, documentation, performance awareness, maintainability) for reviewing the finished Driftwood platform — or any data project in this path — against a real professional standard. Shared across this catalog's data engineering and analytics engineering paths.
